decisions.physicalWaxFormat: 16 total cards per pack; 36 packs per box; includes one Select Stat Leader.
decisions.subsets: Award Winners, Draft Picks, All-Star Caricatures, Highlights, World Series Highlights and Dream Team remain in the full 660-card Base checklist.
decisions.insertOdds: Select Stat Leaders 1:1 regular/jumbo; Franchise 1:24 foil; Boys of Summer 1:4 jumbo.
decisions.channelAbstraction: Boys of Summer is jumbo-exclusive physically; retain published 1:4 per-pack ratio in the universal VCS pack. Franchise retains published 1:24 foil ratio. No adjustment for jumbo card count or assumed channel market share. Inserts replace base slots.
decisions.jumboSizeDiscrepancy: BaseballCardPedia lists 27-card Superpacks; Beckett lists 35-card jumbo packs. Canonical VCS format uses verified 16-card foil packs, so no disputed jumbo-size conversion is used.
decisions.exclusions: Gold Dream Team is a wrapper mail-in set, not a pack parallel. Promos and separate Select, Select Rookie/Traded and other boxed products excluded.
